summary: Session-flag-gated update: when the session active flag at this+0x0 equals 1 and the packed trigger flag read by PackedFlagRead_9a00 at this+2 is not set, loads the session time from dbl_8AFEA0 and passes it together with a pointer to the session message count dword_7D2E50 to CallWrapper_9870.

local_names.this: session object carrying the active flag at 0x0 and the packed trigger flag at +2
local_names.v1: uninitialized ecx value forwarded to CallWrapper_9870
local_names.v2: session time value loaded from dbl_8AFEA0

operations.description: Guard this[0] == 1: the session active flag must be set for the body to run.
PackedFlagRead_9a00 reads a packed bit flag from this+2 used as the trigger check.
Guard the negated result of PackedFlagRead_9a00: the body only runs while the packed trigger flag at this+2 is not yet set.
v2 = dbl_8AFEA0: load the current session time global.
CallWrapper_9870(v1, &dword_7D2E50, 0, v2): process the session update passing the session message count dword_7D2E50 and the session time v2.

unresolved: v1 (held in ecx) is read by CallWrapper_9870 but never assigned in this function; the packet's raw source leaves it undefined.
The packed flag read by PackedFlagRead_9a00 at this+2 is a session/trigger flag; its bit layout and setter are not established in this packet.
